title: Grandpa's Freckles Are All White LIES 🥞
description:
Here, every white lie costs you a freckle. My cousin got one for "love the sweater." Our weatherman looks like a giraffe.

My grandpa has eighteen thousand, and a new one shows up on his nose every morning at 8:02. Grandma has one. So on Sunday I went over for breakfast to watch.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Does Grandma know her pancakes are bad? Watch her freckles before you answer.
